metadata.crowdmesh:note: Minimal no-network MapLibre style. It has NO remote tile source (the app is offline-only), just a flat background plus the locally-computed heatmap layer that MeshHeatmapLayerBuilder injects at runtime. Replace this with a real vector/raster style backed by a bundled .mbtiles region extract for an actual basemap — see app/src/main/assets/map/README.md.
